name: Nested & Chained Conditionals
equipment: A computer with Python 3 installed (or an online REPL like replit.com)
instructions: This lesson covers nested & chained conditionals.
You can chain conditions with elif, or nest one if inside another for more specific checks.
Type the example into a real Python file (or REPL), run it, then modify it until you understand why it behaves that way.
